notes_for_editor: The 1985 sale and move are stated the same way on three pages (register, firelookout.com, relocated list), though the first two share wording and likely a common source. The only current-tense claim, that it still stands at the farm, is the register's 'where it stands today'; no news item or recent photo was found to confirm it, and the register's text is undated. The association lists it standing, but that list does not name the farm. height_m 12.5 is the register's 41 ft converted to metres, not a figure a source gives in metres. The register's photos (1940s and early 1980s) are already on the parent record us-wa-chewelah-peak, so no new photos were added. A 1948 newspaper quote on administration (Willhite) was not used. The parent record shows status 'relocated' and FFLA 'Tower Gone' for the original, which is consistent. Several Willhite staffing names are on the page; none is used here.
